INSERT INTO OTT_DISCOUNT_INFO ( DISCOUNT_ID, PLATFORM_CODE, PLATFORM_NAME, CATEGORY, TITLE, DISCOUNT_SUMMARY, DESCRIPTION, CARD_OR_COMPANY, TARGET_URL, BADGE_TEXT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, REGULAR_PRICE, DISCOUNT_PRICE ) VALUES ( #{discountId}, #{platformCode}, #{platformName}, #{category}, #{title}, #{discountSummary}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cardOrCompany, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{badgeText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{isActive, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), SYSDATE, #{regularPrice, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{discountPrice, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OTT_DISCOUNT_INFO SET PLATFORM_CODE = #{platformCode}, PLATFORM_NAME = #{platformName}, CATEGORY = #{category}, TITLE = #{title}, DISCOUNT_SUMMARY = #{discountSummary}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CARD_OR_COMPANY = #{cardOrCompany, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TARGET_URL = #{targetUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BADGE_TEXT = #{badgeText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DATE = #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, END_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_ACTIVE = NVL(#{isActive, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_ACTIVE), REGULAR_PRICE = #{regularPrice, jdbcType=INTEGER}, DISCOUNT_PRICE = #{discountPrice, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE DISCOUNT_ID = #{discountId}
UPDATE OTT_DISCOUNT_INFO SET IS_ACTIVE = 'N' WHERE END_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
mapper.select:
WITH BASE AS ( SELECT PLATFORM_CODE, PLATFORM_NAME, CATEGORY, TITLE, CARD_OR_COMPANY, REGULAR_PRICE, DISCOUNT_PRICE FROM OTT_DISCOUNT_INFO WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND REGULAR_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND (START_DATE IS NULL OR START_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND (END_DATE IS NULL OR END_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ), REG AS ( /* * [버그 수정] 같은 PLATFORM_CODE라도 행마다 REGULAR_PRICE가 다르다 * (예: NETFLIX의 네이버플러스 멤버십 행은 7,000원이지만, 실제 넷플릭스 * 정가는 17,000원). 단순 MIN(REGULAR_PRICE)를 쓰면 다른 상품(멤버십 결합 * 상품 자체의 가격)이 플랫폼의 정가로 잘못 채택될 수 있다. * 따라서 CARD/TELECOM 행의 정가를 우선 사용하고(카드/통신사 할인은 * 항상 그 플랫폼 자체 정가 기준으로 등록되어 있어 신뢰할 수 있다), * CARD/TELECOM 행이 아예 없는 플랫폼(왓챠, 쿠팡플레이처럼 멤버십 * 결합으로만 이용 가능한 경우)에 한해 전체 MIN(REGULAR_PRICE)로 대체한다. */ SELECT PLATFORM_CODE, PLATFORM_NAME, COALESCE( MIN(CASE WHEN CATEGORY IN ('CARD', 'TELECOM') THEN REGULAR_PRICE END), MIN(REGULAR_PRICE) ) AS REGULAR_PRICE FROM BASE GROUP BY PLATFORM_CODE, PLATFORM_NAME ), ELIGIBLE AS ( SELECT PLATFORM_CODE, TITLE, CARD_OR_COMPANY, CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND DISCOUNT_PRICE < REGULAR_PRICE THEN DISCOUNT_PRICE ELSE REGULAR_PRICE END AS EFFECTIVE_PRICE FROM BASE WHERE 1 = 0
OR (CATEGORY = 'TELECOM' AND CARD_OR_COMPANY = #{telecomCode})
OR (CATEGORY = 'CARD' AND CARD_OR_COMPANY = #{cardCompany})
OR (CATEGORY = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND CARD_OR_COMPANY = #{membershipName})
), RANKED AS ( SELECT PLATFORM_CODE, TITLE, CARD_OR_COMPANY, EFFECTIVE_PRICE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PLATFORM_CODE ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_PRICE ASC) AS RN FROM ELIGIBLE ) SELECT REG.PLATFORM_CODE AS platformCode, REG.PLATFORM_NAME AS platformName, REG.REGULAR_PRICE AS regularPrice, CASE WHEN R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE < REG.REGULAR_PRICE THEN R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE ELSE REG.REGULAR_PRICE END AS bestPrice, CASE WHEN R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE < REG.REGULAR_PRICE THEN R.CARD_OR_COMPANY ELSE NULL END AS discountSource, CASE WHEN R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND R.EFFECTIVE_PRICE < REG.REGULAR_PRICE THEN R.TITLE ELSE NULL END AS discountTitle FROM REG LEFT JOIN RANKED R ON R.PLATFORM_CODE = REG.PLATFORM_CODE AND R.RN = 1 ORDER BY REG.PLATFORM_CODE
